included.name: KeePass
included.description: Offline password manager that encrypts your local database with a master key only you control.
included.note: Windows-first interface; other platforms rely on official ports and community forks.
included.verified_finding: Homepage: free, open source password safe.

included.name: LessPass
included.description: Deterministic password generator that derives passwords locally from a master password without storing a vault.
included.note: Hosted server no longer accepts new registrations; browser extension and CLI still work.

included.name: 2FAS
included.description: Open-source authenticator that generates two-factor codes and approves logins via a browser extension.
included.note: Password-manager extras are basic; core 2FA is completely free.

included.name: GnuPG
included.description: Complete OpenPGP implementation for encrypting, signing and verifying files and email from the command line.
included.note: Command-line oriented; graphical frontends installed separately.

included.name: Mullvad Browser
included.description: Free browser built with the Tor Project that applies Firefox hardening to resist fingerprinting.
included.note: No built-in VPN; pair with a VPN or Tor for network anonymity.
included.verified_finding: Free of charge and open source, with or without the VPN.

included.name: Proton VPN Free
included.description: Unlimited free VPN with no ads and a no-logs policy.
included.note: 1 device, no P2P or streaming servers, fewer countries than paid.
included.verified_finding: Unlimited, free-forever plan: 1 device, no ads, no logs.

included.name: Windscribe
included.description: VPN with an ongoing free plan giving 10GB of data each month once you confirm your email address.
included.note: 10GB/month cap; fewer server locations than paid.
included.verified_finding: Confirm email to get 10GB every month.

included.name: hide.me
included.description: VPN with a permanently free plan allowing one device and 10GB per month under an audited no-logs policy.
included.note: 1 device, 10GB/month.
included.verified_finding: FAQ: free users get 1 device and 10GB/month, always free, no trial.

included.name: Pi-hole
included.description: Network-wide DNS sinkhole that blocks ads and trackers for every device on your home network.
included.note: Needs a local machine or Raspberry Pi and DNS changes.

included.name: AdGuard Home
included.description: Self-hosted network-wide filter that stops ads, trackers and malicious domains before they reach your devices.
included.note: Some advanced filtering/reporting limited to paid AdGuard apps.

included.name: NoScript
included.description: Firefox extension that blocks scripts, frames and active content on untrusted sites until you allow them.
included.note: Default-deny can break pages until per-site permissions granted.

included.name: Simplewall
included.description: Windows firewall front-end that lets you allow or block app connections using the platform's WFP engine.
included.note: Notify mode prompts on first connection until rules defined.

included.name: LuLu
included.description: Free open-source macOS firewall that blocks unknown outgoing connections until you approve them.
included.note: Outbound focus; inbound handled by built-in macOS firewall.

included.name: OpenSnitch
included.description: Application-level firewall for Linux that prompts you or applies rules when programs reach the network.
included.note: Per-connection prompts can be noisy until tuned.

included.name: Portmaster
included.description: Free application firewall that monitors connections, blocks trackers and shows network activity history.
included.note: Network history, bandwidth graphs and the SPN privacy VPN are paid.
included.verified_finding: GPL-3.0; free and open-source application firewall.

included.name: Lynis
included.description: Command-line security auditing tool that scans Linux and macOS hosts and reports hardening improvements.
included.note: Community edition free; compliance reporting and enterprise support paid.
included.verified_finding: Free to use (GPL); Enterprise sold separately.

included.name: O&O ShutUp10
included.description: Portable freeware that gathers Windows 10 and 11 privacy settings so telemetry and data sharing can be disabled.
included.note: Apply at your own risk; paid Premium re-enforces settings after updates.
included.verified_finding: Freeware, no installation, will remain free.

included.name: Malwarebytes Free Virus Scanner
included.subcategory: Breach checking, malware scanning and network diagnostics
included.description: Free on-demand scanner that detects and removes malware and unwanted programs.
included.note: Free edition scans on demand only; real-time protection requires Premium.
included.verified_finding: Free virus scanner; real-time features Premium.

included.name: Mozilla Monitor
included.subcategory: Breach checking, malware scanning and network diagnostics
included.description: Scans whether your email, phone number or personal data leaked in known breaches and alerts you.
included.note: Continuous monitoring, alerts and removal help beyond basic scans require paid Monitor Plus.
included.verified_finding: Scan for exposures; notified when data appears in a breach.

included.name: mitmproxy
included.subcategory: Breach checking, malware scanning and network diagnostics
included.description: Interactive HTTPS interception proxy for inspecting and modifying traffic between your apps and the internet.
included.note: Requires installing its CA cert; for auditing your own traffic (MIT license).
included.verified_finding: Free and open-source interactive HTTPS proxy.

included.name: Angry IP Scanner
included.subcategory: Breach checking, malware scanning and network diagnostics
included.description: Fast cross-platform scanner that pings IP ranges and collects ports, hostnames and MAC addresses.
included.note: Extra data gathering comes from community plugins.

included.name: Process Monitor
included.description: Real-time Windows tool that logs file, registry, process and network activity to troubleshoot problems.
included.note: Huge event volume; filters needed.

included.name: Autoruns
included.description: Shows every program that starts automatically with Windows so you can safely disable unwanted entries.
included.note: Disabling the wrong entry can break startup programs.

included.name: Rufus
included.description: Creates bootable USB drives from ISO images with options for UEFI, NTFS and unattended Windows installs.
included.note: Windows-only.

included.name: Ventoy
included.description: Boots ISO files straight from a USB drive so you can store many images and pick one at startup.
included.note: A few exotic/old ISOs may need special boot flags.

included.name: HxD
included.description: Hex and disk editor for Windows that edits files, memory and raw drives with checksums and comparisons.
included.note: Editing raw disks/memory can corrupt data if careless.
included.verified_finding: Free of charge for private and commercial use.

included.name: ImHex
included.description: Pattern-aware hex editor with data analysis, structure dissection and scripting for binary data.
included.note: Learning curve, especially the pattern language.

included.name: HWiNFO
included.description: Deep hardware analyzer for Windows reporting sensors, temperatures, voltages and component details in real time.
included.note: Free for personal, non-commercial use.

included.name: Eraser
included.description: Securely overwrites deleted files, free space and entire drives on Windows using configurable wipe patterns.
included.note: Multi-pass wiping of large disks is slow.

included.name: Scoop
included.description: Command-line installer for Windows that adds apps without admin prompts, UAC dialogs or PATH clutter.
included.note: Primarily scriptable/portable apps; GUI apps via community buckets.

included.name: Stats
included.description: Menu-bar system monitor for macOS showing CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, battery and sensor readings.
included.note: Some modules add overhead; fan control unmaintained.

included.name: Homebrew
included.description: Package manager for macOS and Linux that installs and updates command-line tools from the terminal.
included.note: Requires terminal comfort.

included.name: btop
included.description: Resource monitor with a graphical terminal interface for CPU, memory, disks, network and processes.
included.note: Terminal only; true color recommended.

included.name: Windows Terminal
included.description: Modern Windows terminal hosting PowerShell, CMD and WSL in customizable tabs and panes.
included.note: Windows 10 or later.

included.name: Alacritty
included.description: GPU-accelerated terminal emulator focused on speed and simplicity, configured through a plain text file.
included.note: No tabs or splits by design; pair with tmux.

included.name: kitty
included.description: Fast GPU-based terminal with tabs, splits, ligatures and remote control over a scriptable protocol.
included.note: Configured via text config file.

included.name: Ghostty
included.description: Cross-platform terminal with a native UI, tabs and splits emphasizing speed and platform integration.
included.note: Younger project; config option names shifted between releases.

included.name: iTerm2
included.description: Feature-rich macOS terminal with search, split panes, tmux integration and a Python scripting API.
included.note: macOS only; optional AI chat window is an add-on.

included.name: Clonezilla
included.description: Bootable tool for full-disk imaging and cloning with many filesystems and encrypted images.
included.note: No live/differential backups; destination must be >= source size.

included.name: GParted
included.description: Graphical partition editor that resizes, copies and moves partitions without data loss from bootable media.
included.note: Runs from live media; partitions must be unmounted.

included.name: FreeFileSync
included.description: Compares and synchronizes folders with mirror, update and two-way modes on Windows, macOS and Linux.
included.note: Free for private, personal use; businesses need paid Business edition.
included.verified_finding: Free for private individuals; paid Business edition.

included.name: AOMEI Backupper Standard
included.description: Free Windows backup software covering system, disk, partition and file backups plus basic disk cloning.
included.note: Standard free for personal use; advanced cloning/server features paid.

included.name: Tails
included.subcategory: NEW: Privacy and security focused desktop operating systems
included.description: Amnesic live OS on a USB stick that routes all traffic through Tor and leaves no trace on the host.
included.note: Slower browsing through Tor; persistent storage must be configured.
included.verified_finding: Free software from the Tor Project.

included.name: Qubes OS
included.subcategory: NEW: Privacy and security focused desktop operating systems
included.description: Security-focused OS that isolates separate tasks in virtual machines so one compromise cannot spread.
included.note: Demands capable hardware and a learning curve.

included.name: QEMU
included.subcategory: Remote desktop, virtualization and network monitoring
included.description: Generic open-source machine emulator and virtualizer that runs whole OS images or single programs.
included.note: CLI-oriented; desktop users pair with libvirt or a GUI front-end.
included.verified_finding: Generic open source machine emulator and virtualizer.

rejected.name: Mullvad VPN
rejected.reason: No free tier or trial; only paid 5 EUR/month plans.

rejected.name: Macrium Reflect Free
rejected.reason: Free edition no longer offered to new users.

rejected.name: LastPass
rejected.reason: Free plan limited to a single device type.

rejected.name: Parallels Desktop
rejected.reason: Paid subscription with short trial only.

rejected.name: CCleaner
rejected.reason: Restricted free edition with upsells rather than genuinely free core.

rejected.name: Fiddler Everywhere
rejected.reason: Subscription with 30-day trial; free Classic discontinued.

rejected.name: Avast Free Antivirus
rejected.reason: Key protections gated behind Premium; bundled upsells.

rejected.name: VMware Workstation Pro
rejected.reason: Personal-use free license could not be verified from official pages (404/login walls).

rejected.name: MiniTool Partition Wizard Free
rejected.reason: Official free-edition pages 404'd; current offering unverifiable.

rejected.name: DBAN
rejected.reason: Unsupported for SSDs, no updates, vendor steers to paid Blancco.

notes: 56 candidates researched; 45 included, 11 rejected. Six NEW subcategories proposed: 'Free VPN tiers', 'Firewalls and traffic filtering', 'Security hardening and auditing', 'Terminal emulators', 'Backup, cloning and partitioning', 'Privacy and security focused desktop operating systems'. Medium confidence: Eraser (SourceForge), HWiNFO (vendor terms), mitmproxy (dual-use scope).
